source: Pixel-sampled directly from the official Windows Package Manager icon in microsoft/winget-cli, .github/images/WindowsPackageManager_Assets/ICO/PNG/_256.png (github.com/microsoft/winget-cli). No design-token/sass source exists for winget (it's a CLI, not a themed web app) and no separate SVG asset was published alongside the PNG in that repo at research time, so every hex below is a real sampled pixel from that authoritative icon rather than a screenshot of a rendered page or an invented value — see the (x,y) coordinates in each role's note. Package metadata (name, publisher, description, version) comes from microsoft/winget-pkgs, the same org's official community package-manifest repo.
watermarkNote: The icon's own package-with-arrow glyph, reused faint as the corner watermark (same pattern as the PyPI card's cubes).

gradientDark.token: icon fold shadow, darkest opaque non-white pixel in the asset
gradientDark.note: sampled at (51,31) — found by scanning the whole 256x256 icon for the lowest-luminance opaque, non-white pixel

chip.note: sampled at (128,30), the shadow gradient between the top and second folder-tab bands

text.note: the icon's own download arrow renders as near-white (#f9f9f9 sampled) — using pure white for text keeps it consistent with the PyPI/GitHub cards

rule.note: winget has no web design system to source a border token from (unlike PyPI's $transparent-white or GitHub's borderColor.default) — reuses the same semi-transparent-white convention as the PyPI card for hairlines on a colour panel

accent.note: sampled at (30,75) — the icon is monochromatic gold with no second brand hue, so the accent is the icon's own lightest tone rather than an unrelated colour

type.source: winget is a CLI with no branded webfont (its own terminal banner uses the console's font) — reuses the same embedded Source Sans 3 / Source Code Pro as the other cards for visual consistency.

logoUsageNote: The Windows Package Manager icon is a Microsoft asset — use it to refer to winget itself, not to brand something else.
